translations.web: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
translations.bsb: Many a man proclaims his loving devotion, but who can find a trustworthy man?
translations.kjv: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
translations.asv: Most men will proclaim every one his own kindness; But a faithful man who can find?
